content:
maria: quick sync — we need to lock the design partner plan for the Private cohort. Target ~8-12 partners, mix of VPC and on-prem. main asks: validate onboarding docs, security checklist, and rollback/runbook. timeline: recruit this month, onboard next month. any major blockers?
chris: thumbs on count/roles. i can draft outreach + 1-pager. propose 2-week onboarding window per partner so eng can focus.
raj: +1. can we offer $X credits + 6 months of dedicated support as incentive? also propose a short survey after each sync for signal capture.
elaine: from eng: on-prem setups add ~3 dev-days each. if we take 2 on-prem, we'll need schedule buffers. vpc-only partners are much faster. recommend 6 vpc / 2 on-prem split.
sophia: suggested success metrics (short):
- onboarding lead time <= 3 business days for VPC
- partner-reported setup friction <= 2 on a 5pt scale
- 3 case studies / 5 concrete asks surfaced
- signal: 80% completion of weekly quick survey
maria: nice — also want explicit go/no-go criteria for launch: security sign-off, docs >80% coverage, 2 partners through full trial without rollback.
chris: outreach DM draft (feel free to reuse):
```
Hi {{name}},
We're running a small Private design partner cohort at Redwood — 8-week pilot to validate onboarding and security workflows. We'll provide dedicated engineering support, credits, and a final findings report. Expect ~3 short syncs + quick weekly check-ins. Interested in learning more?
```
raj: i'd add a line about time commitment: "~3 hours/month" so partners know expectations. also ask for a technical contact and an exec sponsor.
elaine: ops note: need a feature-flag plan for canarying any infra helpers. plus a rollback playbook template — i'll add to the repo and link in the invite.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: docs/private-onboard-playbook v0.3 pushed to tools/docsite by elaine — https://internal.redwood/docs/private-onboard-playbook
maria: recruitment channel plan: chris to DM top 20 candidates, raj to run targeted email to existing accounts, and i'll loop in CS for warm intros. target commit deadline 10 days from now.
sophia: feedback cadence proposal: weekly 20-min async form + biweekly 45-min sync. use a short prompt set we can reuse for regression checks.
chris: +1 on short prompt set. i can build the initial eval harness and share.
raj: question on incentives: do we make credits conditional on completing feedback surveys? maybe a small portion withheld to encourage participation.
maria: let's not gate credits — keep it friendly. but add an "engagement bonus" if partners complete >90% of touchpoints.
elaine: scheduling constraint: two engineers are on rotation next month. i'll block capacity for onboarding weeks now.
maria: action items: chris = outreach draft + eval harness, raj = incentives/email, elaine = playbook + capacity, sophia = survey + success metrics template. i'll compile and run a 30-min sync Friday.
chris: I'll post draft DM in #product-dp-drafts in an hour.
raj: i'll prepare the incentive wording and a simple T&Cs snippet.
sophia: prepping survey in Typeform, will share sample questions.
maria: perfect. small note: keep asks short and concrete — partners are busy. :thumbsup:
